user.title: Garbage View
user.description: Create the integration. Add waste types from its options.

init.title: Waste types
init.description: Add, edit or remove waste types. Changes are applied when you choose Save and close.

preset.title: New waste type
preset.description: Pick a ready-made type to prefill name and icon (you can change both), or choose Custom.

details.title: Waste type
details.description: Name, icon and how often it is collected.

data_description.icon: Search the list, or type any Material Design icon, e.g. mdi:food-apple (browse them at pictogrammers.com/library/mdi)
data_description.pickup: When the truck comes. Morning: reminder and highlight start the evening before. Evening: they start the same day.

data_description.anchor_date: Any date in a week when collection happens

rule_monthly_nth_weekday.title: Day of the month (e.g. first Monday)

data_description.day: If the month is shorter, the last day is used

notifications.title: Mobile notifications
notifications.description: Sends a push notification to the Home Assistant app listing what to put out: the evening before for types collected in the morning, the same day for types collected in the evening. Text follows the Home Assistant language. Use {placeholders} in custom texts.

data_description.title_template: Leave empty for the default text
data_description.message_template: Leave empty for the default text
data_description.evening_time: For types collected in the morning: reminder time the evening before
data_description.time: For types collected in the evening: reminder time on the day
data_description.put_out_from: From this time the card lights up the types collected tomorrow morning

error.invalid_name: Enter a name of 1 to 40 characters, unique among your waste types.
error.duplicate_name: A waste type with this name already exists.
error.invalid_template: Max 200 characters; use only the listed placeholders.

abort.max_types: You reached the maximum of 20 waste types.

send_test_notification.name: Send test notification
send_test_notification.description: Sends the notification now to the configured devices, ignoring the schedule.

no_delivery.message: No notification was delivered. Check the selected devices.
